ctx.x: And the fat leather kid, John.

Yeah. But if Polite would have listened at me, he might have got round the championship. You know he wouldn't have listened at some of them boys there, man, don't stay here, you can make money after that. Do you know if he'd listen to Albert Greger he would have. Yeah, that's what I'm saying now. That other gang took him, persuaded him to go away, and he went out there and fight. A boy out there would have had a little bit more experience than him. Hard knock. A little Filipino. He was Mexican. That Mexican.…
